entities.summary: Jordan E. Walsh is an American professional basketball player for the Boston Celtics of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Arkansas Razorbacks. He was a consensus five-star recruit and one of the top players in the 2022 class. Drafted in the second round of the 2023 NBA Draft, Walsh won a championship as a rookie with the 2023–24 Boston Celtics.
